Hong Kong's trade watched eight jewellery brands attend a Beijing diamond pact and not sign it.

The Shanghai Diamond Exchange signed the Beijing Declaration on Natural Diamonds with Botswana, Namibia and South Africa on 15 September; De Beers witnessed it. Chow Tai Fook and seven more attended; the release lists none of them as a signatory.

香港珠寶業界注意：上海鑽石交易所聯同博茨瓦納、納米比亞及南非政府於9月15日在北京簽署《北京天然鑽石與可持續發展宣言》，戴比爾斯到場見證；周大福等八個品牌出席儀式，惟宣言未列任何一方為簽署人。
